title: [MTR] MI2N / Z22500 (RER A / RER E)
description: MI2N addon for Minecraft Transit Railway.
body:
This addon for Minecraft Transit Railway adds the MI2N Alteo (from the RER A line) and Eole (from the RER E line) to the game.
It contains 3 different trainsets:
1. Alteo (old)
2. Alteo refurbished
3. Eole (Z22500)

They can be used in single or double-units with coupling. Also inter-compatible with [MI09 cars](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mtr-mi09).
